subject.title: fix(auto-reply): preserve Unicode in context treemap label truncation

question: Should context-treemap labels remain ASCII-sanitized, or should OpenClaw support Unicode labels as an end-to-end rendered-output contract?
rationale: The current helper receives sanitized ASCII in production, so a private code-point change alone neither fixes a reported user path nor defines whether Unicode output is supported by the renderer and layout.

options.title: Keep the ASCII contract
options.body: Decline this speculative helper-only hardening and retain the existing sanitizer-to-renderer behavior.

options.title: Adopt Unicode labels end to end
options.body: Sponsor a bounded follow-up that updates the input contract, renderer/font or measurement assumptions, and focused output coverage.

options.title: Accept defensive hardening only
options.body: Merge the helper change as future-proofing while explicitly documenting that it does not add Unicode treemap rendering support.

recommendation.title: Keep the ASCII contract
recommendation.body: Decline this speculative helper-only hardening and retain the existing sanitizer-to-renderer behavior.
